responsibility: This module is GCC’s target backend for the Cell Synergistic Processing Unit (SPU), covering both machine-dependent code generation and the SPU-specific programming interface exposed to C-family users. Its core backend files define the architectural contract, target hooks, options, machine modes, operand predicates and constraints, and the main RTL machine descriptions that drive instruction selection, scheduling, register and immediate legality, calling convention, stack frame handling, atomics, and ELF object/link behavior for SPU code. A second major area is SPU builtin and intrinsic support: builtin definition tables, intrinsic-specific RTL expanders, frontend overload resolution and preprocessor hooks, plus public headers for vector types, SPU intrinsics, DMA/MFC control, software cache support, and VMX-to-SPU compatibility. Together these file groups make this module the place where GCC maps generic middle-end operations and user-visible SPU intrinsic code onto the SPU architecture’s vector-oriented instruction set, memory-transfer model, and runtime environment.
